candidates.name: Agrus Kos, Spirit of Justice
candidates.oracle_text:
Double strike, vigilance
Whenever Agrus Kos enters or attacks, choose up to one target creature. If it's suspected, exile it. Otherwise, suspect it. (A suspected creature has menace and can't block.)
candidates.synergy: Legendary double striker scales sharply with Miles counters. ETB immediately switches off a blocker; returning through Smile supplies a larger double-striking body and repeats disruption.
candidates.caveats: First unsuspicious target is suspected, not exiled; exile needs a subsequent trigger. No haste.

candidates.name: Hardened Academic
candidates.oracle_text:
Flying, haste
Discard a card: This creature gains lifelink until end of turn.
Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
candidates.synergy: Flying haste makes every return immediately offensive. Discard outlet can bank a genuinely useful Smile target while gaining lifelink; an Academic already in play rewards Smile moving cards out of graveyard.
candidates.caveats: Discard costs a real card, not card advantage. A simultaneous pair leaving graveyard gives one trigger. Do not credit a newly reanimated Academic with watching its own graveyard departure. Nonlegendary, not a Spider.

candidates.name: Emberheart Challenger
candidates.oracle_text:
Haste
Prowess (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.)
Valiant — Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn, exile the top card of your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card.
candidates.synergy: Haste on return; Miles ETB targeting it triggers valiant and provides card access without a pump spell. Solid early attacker even without Smile.
candidates.caveats: Smile targets it in graveyard, not as a battlefield creature, so that targeting does not trigger valiant. Prowess less frequent in creature-heavy shells; nonlegendary, not a Spider.

candidates.name: Raph & Leo, Sibling Rivals
candidates.oracle_text: Whenever Raph & Leo attack, if it's the first combat phase of the turn, untap one or two target attacking creatures. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
candidates.synergy: Legendary 2/4 offers extra combats without delirium or spell-density requirements. Particularly strong with Ultimate attack triggers and other attack payoffs.
candidates.caveats: No haste or ETB; needs to attack in first combat. Untaps only one or two attacking creatures, not the entire team; extra combat has no intervening main phase.

candidates.oracle_text:
This spell can't be countered.
Ward—Pay 2 life.
Spells you control can't be countered.
Other creatures you control have "Ward—Pay 2 life."
candidates.synergy: Two-mana attacker taxes opposing targeted interaction and makes your spells uncounterable, protecting deployment of Miles and Smile. Reanimation immediately restores static protection.
candidates.caveats: Ward is a life payment, not hard protection. Does not stop sweepers or exile-a-spell interaction like Aven Interrupter; nonlegendary, not a Spider.

limitations: Strategic evaluations, not tournament-strength proof, mana validation, Arena playtesting or simulations.
Scryfall legality plus released game:arena printing evidence; no direct Arena client inventory check.
Normal creature deaths are legitimate Smile setup; do not assume an empty or fully stocked graveyard. Smile returns up to two eligible creatures on upkeep and puts a counter on each, not haste.
Smile live auxiliary request received HTTP 429; its stated functionality was supplied by task context. Selected candidate verification requests succeeded.
Uncommon alternatives inspected include Cunning Coyote, Imodane's Recruiter, Kutzil, War Machine, Shrike Force and The Neutrinos; final list favors rare/mythic options.
